artifacts.name: Digital Transformation Operationalized Maturity & Assessment Model
artifacts.description: Digital-business maturity and assessment model. Positions digital transformation as the reimagining of the organization's business and operating model as a digital business: grounded in advanced digital technology adoption (AI, agentic AI, autonomous systems, composable cloud-native platforms, digital twins), expressed through novel operating models across all operating concerns, steered by customer- and ecosystem-centric digital strategy, and run as a deliberate working model between humans and software agents. Every criterion is MECE-placed, carries five evidence-anchored progression levels correlated to the org's canonical L-1..L-5 capability scale (L-0 Not Assessed), and is independently assessable.

touchpoints.label: Operations / Autonomous Operations Seam
touchpoints.contract_summary: CR-AM-13 seam: Operations D5 reliability evidence (observability, predictive detection, auto-remediation, SLO enforcement) feeds the peer's Technology and Operations dimensions; boundary - the peer owns closed-loop OODA autonomy, this model owns human/assisted operations.

touchpoints.label: Operations / Services Delivery Seam
touchpoints.contract_summary: CR-AM-13 seam: Operations D1 daily-operating evidence (flow visibility, WIP, commitment reliability) feeds the peer's flow-efficiency and time-to-market criteria; internal flow health is owned here, customer-visible outcomes by the peer.

touchpoints.label: Operations / Technology Seam
touchpoints.contract_summary: CR-AM-13 seam: this model assumes the peer's platform and tooling capability and scores only the effectiveness of tool use in live operations (D5); capability assessment belongs to the Technology model.

touchpoints.label: Operations / Digital Transformation Seam
touchpoints.contract_summary: CR-AM-13 seam: the composite model's strategy and transformation-roadmap maturity informs this model's D6 criteria; transformation strategy is assessed by the peer, strategy-to-operations linkage here.

touchpoints.label: Operations / DT Operationalized Seam
touchpoints.contract_summary: CR-AM-13 seam: explicit single-owner overlap between Operations D5/D6 and the peer's d4 operations and d5c2 TOM criteria; shared evidence (d4c2, d4c10, d4c11) is single-assessed once and cited by both models.

touchpoints.label: Operations / Modernization Seam
touchpoints.contract_summary: CR-AM-13 seam: both models import the operations-modernization dimension package, single-sourced in maturity-components; component content is never duplicated and each model owns only its scoring of it.

touchpoints.label: Registry Integration Touchpoint
touchpoints.contract_summary: Registers model metadata and assessment indexes in the ecosystem registry spine for cross-model discovery.

touchpoints.label: Shared Capability Touchpoint
touchpoints.contract_summary: Reuses governed maturity component packages (digital-culture, technology-adoption, operations-modernization extend, services-delivery override) for composite capability scoring.

touchpoints.label: Operations Component Reuse Touchpoint
touchpoints.contract_summary: Imports the operations-modernization dimension package (v1.0.0) for deployment and change-automation scoring; shared component content is single-sourced in the component registry.
